context.p: Before you can release a lock on a document, it must be checked out. Releasing a lock reverts the check-out of the document you are working on without checking it in. You can only release a lock when you have the document open in X-Author.

step.cmd: From the X-Author pane, click on the Lock Status tab icon.

stepresult.p: The Lock Status page shows agreement details and information on the current document lock.

step.cmd: Click Release Lock on the Lock Status page.
If you chose to release the lock, the document check-out is reverted. Any changes you made while the document was checked out are not saved.

stepresult.p: The page refreshes to reflect unlocked status and most menu options are disabled.

note.p: If you release a document lock in error and want to continue working with the document, go to the Lock Status page and click Acquire Lock.
